label: Fasten and check actual bands around articles/stacks before storage or shipment
definition: Verify actual article/stack/route, fasten the band using the actual taught method and check every actual closure/restraint/protection criterion before permitted handover. assessment.method: Observe the authored task and changed case; record support, actual result, errors and feedback.
criteria: Fastens actual approved bands around articles and stacks
Checks actual securing result under current storage/shipment criteria
Keeps changed-scope failures, authority and support explicit

evidence_basis: Individually authored Atlas proposal. Source facets are mapped in the profession route; no external practitioner review, learner observation or occupational certification is claimed.
input_specification: A qualified instructor supplies actual harmless article and stack training cases, current band/tool/material plans, specifically taught controls and actual storage/shipment securing checks.
